# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Riney-Scollan 0872988143 are delighted to present this spacious three-bedroom semi-detached home in Rathfarnham, offered in true turn-key condition. This much-loved home has been extensively renovated, incorporating an extension and a full downstairs refurbishment in 2019 designed by interior designer Alannah Monks, creating a modern and inviting living space.
